sinopsis.es: Esta historia de amor real sigue a los carismáticos músicos Zella Day y Jesse Woods mientras se unen para crear la banda de alt-country Chaparelle junto al colaborador Beau Bedford, en un documental con tanto drama como una temporada de Nashville.
sinopsis.en: This real-life love story follows the charismatic musicians Zella Day and Jesse Woods as they team to create the alt-country band Chaparelle with collaborator Beau Bedford, in a documentary with as much drama as a season of Nashville.
